blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Kieffer Alas had one of the best UAAP debuts in recent memory, leading Ateneo to a 101-74 win over University of the East on Wednesday at Mall of Asia Arena. Alas, however, downplayed his dazzling performance that came close to setting a new UAAP record for most points scored in a debut.
